messages:
sam park: Quick sync — proposing vendor roadmap alignment meeting Tue 10am PT. Need to lock embargo windows and a contingency plan across H100 / H200 / MI300 / Gaudi. Draft agenda: 1) vendor delivery dates & risks, 2) marketplace SKU mapping + approvals, 3) SI integration readiness, 4) joint announce playbook. Reply with any hard blockers or must-have agenda items.

raj singh: FYI from vendor side — Nvidia called out potential H200 supply squeeze, looks like a ~3 week slip risk for some SKUs. They recommended we prepare H100 fallback and confirm driver/firmware compatibility. Also B200 availability uncertain for managed instances.

linh tran: Platform check: we have validated images for H100 and MI300 in QA. H200 images are still failing a kernel module test (OOM in perf harness). ETA for a patched image: EOD Fri if no surprises. SI test harness is ready — can run 3-node perf + KV-cache smoke.

raj singh: Habana (Gaudi) requests explicit marketplace SKU mapping and a short integration checklist before they sign the co-marketing waiver. They want assets by May 10 for their PM review.

alice m: SI update — three partners green, one wants early lab access for driver validation. Requesting 2-week dedicated capacity (2x A100-equivalent) starting next Mon. Can platform allocate?

linh tran: We can allocate a short burst reserved pool for SI testing. Need an infra ticket with dates and exact instance types.

chris ramos: Legal note — our co-marketing MSA needs an explicit embargo-change clause for vendor-driven slips. I'll draft an amendment template (simple addendum) and circulate for review.

sam park: Marketing concerns?

taylor ng: Marketing: please avoid setting an external embargo until vendors confirm ship dates. If H200 slips, we should do a phased announcement: high-level capability + marketplace listing first, then HW-specific callouts once inventory is firm. I can draft phased messaging if we get dates by Wed COB. Also need final logo/asset approval flow for partners.

linh tran: Quick fallback runbook snippet (for the playbook) — use this in the rollout automation: 
```yaml
routing_policy:
  primary: [h200, h100, mi300]
  fallback: route_to_compatible_variant
  fallback_timeout_ms: 250

model_variant_map:
  large: [h200-8x, h100-8x, mi300-16x]
```
This lets us prefer H200 but automatically route to H100/MI300 if capacity or drivers fail.

sam park: Action items I hear: raj confirm vendor dates + SKU mapping by Wed; linh deliver H200 test image by EOD Fri and open infra ticket for SI lab; alice confirm exact SI partner dates and instance types; taylor prepare phased announcement draft by Wed COB; chris draft MSA addendum. I'll own the joint playbook doc and scheduling.

raj singh: Will ping vendors now and lock dates — will update here by Wed.

alice m: I'll get the partner dates today and file the infra ticket.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Created recurring event "Vendor Roadmap Sync (partnerships)" Tue 10:00 PT — invites sent to participants.

sam park: Thanks everyone — please flag any hard blockers ASAP. If anyone wants to sync 1:1 before Tue, ping me.
